items.title: Corrupt Comment: Anti-corruption foundation criticism
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts using AI to generate comments criticizing a Russian anti-corruption foundation and related figures.

items.title: Tort Report: Abusive reporting activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts using AI to draft abusive reports and complaints targeting Vietnamese public figures and platforms.

items.title: Rwandan election content: Political commenting network
items.summary: OpenAI banned Rwanda-origin accounts using AI to generate partisan comments ahead of the country’s elections.

items.title: Bet Bot: Gambling spam network
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts that accessed its models through an Israel-based startup to generate conversations and send links to gambling sites on X.

items.title: Operation “STORM-2035”: Iran-origin influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned Iran-origin STORM-2035 accounts using AI to generate US and UK election content and publish it across sites.

items.title: Operation “A2Z”: Multilingual influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned “A2Z” accounts using AI to generate multilingual influence content about elections, Ukraine, and politics across platforms.

items.title: Operation “Stop News”: Russia-origin influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned Russia-origin “Stop News” accounts using AI to generate multilingual articles and posts targeting Ukraine and the West.

items.title: Hoax: Fake Russian “troll” error message
items.summary: OpenAI banned an account that likely originated in the US and used AI to create a fake ChatGPT error message claiming to detect “Russian troll” activity.

items.title: CyberAv3ngers: Iran-linked cyber research activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to belong to CyberAv3ngers using AI to research industrial control systems, default credentials, and targets.

items.title: SweetSpecter: China-linked cyber activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts likely belonging to a suspected China-based adversary tracked as SweetSpecter, using AI to research vulnerabilities, write code, and support spear-phishing activity.

items.title: STORM-0817: Iran-linked malware and scraping activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned Iran-linked STORM-0817 accounts using AI to debug Android malware, scrape social platforms, and translate tooling.
